Hi Amit / Elena —

Quick weekly checkpoint on the MAP and evaluation plan ahead of next week's acceptance window. This thread captures the status we discussed in Wednesday's call and lists concrete owners for each acceptance gate. Attaching the latest MAP grid and the evaluation checklist for reference.

Summary (top-line)
- Overall PO C progress: green/amber (workload-dependent throughput still needs verification)
- Acceptance windows: initial data ingestion validation scheduled 2027-04-27; performance acceptance scheduled 2027-05-04
- Primary blocker: ingestion throughput degradation under concurrent requests (see Karthik's note below)

Concrete asks
1) Finera: please confirm the two sample datasets for throughput validation by EOD Monday (2027-04-19).
2) Redwood: we will deliver updated quantization config and a perf run by 2027-04-24.
3) Joint decision: if perf SLOs not met on 2027-04-24 run, fallback plan is to (a) extend the acceptance window by one week OR (b) apply the tuned quantization profile and rerun — decision needed by 2027-04-25.

Action owners (short):
- Data samples: Amit Shah (Finera) — verify sample sets (ACTION-1)
- Ingestion logs & throttling investigation: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — deliver root cause and mitigation notes (ACTION-2)
- Quantization/serving config: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — provide tuned profile + perf run command (ACTION-3)
- Acceptance checklist sign-off: Elena Petrova (Finera) + Marissa Cole (Redwood) — coordinate on 2027-04-27 (ACTION-4)

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (row-level owners), evaluation_checklist.pdf (test matrix)

Neha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — POC milestones, open acceptance gates, owner commitments

Thanks Neha — quick update from the infra/serving side after running a targeted load test Friday:

Findings
- Ingestion path shows a ~18% tail-latency increase when we run 8 concurrent streams vs baseline 2 streams; causes appear to be backpressure on the prefix cache and a suboptimal batching heuristic for the customer's request shape.
- No functional correctness issues; evaluation tests in the checklist still pass.

Immediate mitigation options (we recommend options in priority order)
1) Apply a temporary tighter batching window for Finera's traffic class (reduces throughput ~6% but cuts tail latency by ~12%) — ETA to patch: 2027-04-22 (Vivek to apply).
2) Enable prefix-KV sharding across two serving nodes to reduce cache contention — ETA: 2027-04-24 (requires one maintenance restart across nodes).
3) If above not acceptable, schedule acceptance extension to 2027-05-11 and mark performance gate as amber-red.

Next steps
- Vivek to provide tuned config and perf run steps by 2027-04-22 (ACTION-3).
- Amit to confirm dataset availability (ACTION-1).
- Neha/Marissa to prepare sign-off doc once perf run results are in (ACTION-4).

Attachment: short perf result snippet attached to the MAP workbook (see MAP_v2.xlsx).

- Karthik
Lead Systems Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Amit — good to see the sample sets in Drive (I confirmed ACL). Responses inline and updated decisions: 

Answers to questions:
1) Tighter batching window: this will only affect latency/throughput and batching behavior; deterministic outputs for the evaluation checklist remain unchanged for this customer profile. We call this a "performance-only" tweak.
2) Perf run pass/fail metrics (added to evaluation_checklist.pdf):
   - Median latency (token-level) <= 120ms
   - 95th percentile latency <= 380ms under the 8-stream test
   - Throughput >= 220 reqs/min for the bulk ingestion job
   - No increase in semantic error rate > 0.5% (evaluation harness)

Decisions / commitments
- We will apply option (1) on 2027-04-22 into a staging slot and run a full perf sweep on 2027-04-24 (Redwood: Vivek & Karthik).
- If 95th >= 380ms on 2027-04-24, we will (as previously noted) either enable KV sharding and rerun or extend acceptance to 2027-05-11; decision to be made by 2027-04-25 close of business (joint).

Updated action tracker (owners + due dates)

- ACTION-2: ingestion logs & root cause writeup — Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — due 2027-04-23

- ACTION-4: acceptance sign-off doc & final checklist — Marissa Cole (Redwood) & Elena Petrova (Finera) — sync on 2027-04-27

I'll run a short 30-min sync on Monday 2027-04-25 at 15:00 UTC to finalize the decision if performance is borderline; invite will follow.

Neha

Quick sync note after today's perf run (summary for the MAP):

Result snapshot
- 8-stream perf run completed at 2027-04-24 02:30 UTC using Finera samples (payments_anon_v2.ndjson).
- Median latency: 112ms (PASS)
- 95th percentile: 395ms (FAIL, above 380ms threshold)
- Throughput: 228 reqs/min (PASS)
- Semantic error rate: 0.3% (PASS)

Implication and proposed immediate steps
- Performance gate is amber. Root cause analysis (Karthik) points to persistent cache contention under certain concurrent prefixes.
- Proposed short-term remediation: enable KV sharding (option 2) in the maintenance window 2027-04-24 02:00-04:00 UTC as Amit offered, then rerun the same perf sweep overnight and re-evaluate. Vivek and Karthik please confirm you can complete this tonight and report back by 2027-04-26 09:00 UTC.

Sign-off plan
- If 95th <= 380ms after sharding + rerun, Marissa and Elena will sign acceptance on 2027-04-27 per the checklist. If not, we will extend acceptance window to 2027-05-11 and schedule additional tuning.

Attachments referenced in MAP: MAP_v2.xlsx (updated with run results row), evaluation_checklist.pdf (unchanged)

Thanks everyone — small ask from Finera: if you can confirm the maintenance window time once more, we'll proceed.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
